decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where a pool can be empty for a valid input (causing panic or silent fallback), then where pool sizes create observable repetition.
focus: Completeness and distribution of prefix/base/suffix pool data — counts, tier assignments, degenerate empty-pool edge cases
name: fd-name-pool-coverage
persona: A procedural content designer who audits name generator tables for coverage gaps, collision rates, and perceived variety.
review_areas: Verify all 8 mood-ranged prefix pools are non-empty for every reachable mood_net value
Confirm 12 base-type pools (4 tiers × 3 families) are all populated with at least 3 entries
Check all 5 suffix pools contain at least 2 entries
Audit cross-pool collisions — same entry in multiple pools reduces variety
Count total unique combinations: confirm >10000 to avoid duplicates in normal play
success_hints: No valid input tuple maps to an empty pool
task_context: Procedural art naming system for elven colony sim: mood-ranged prefixes (8 pools), genre families (3: Classical/Anachronistic/Nature), skill-tiered base types (4 tiers), inspiration-source suffixes (5 pools).
